namespace Pipeline.Generated

/-- Parse a decimal numeral; 0 signals malformed input (outside modeled scope). -/
def parseNat (s : String) : Nat :=
  (s.toNat?).getD 0

/-- Parse a range spec "A-B" into (A, B); (0, 0) on malformed input. -/
def parseRange (s : String) : Nat × Nat :=
  match s.splitOn "-" with
  | [a, b] => (parseNat a, parseNat b)
  | _ => (0, 0)

/-- Characters A..B (1-indexed, inclusive) of one line's character list. -/
def cutChars (a b : Nat) (l : List Char) : List Char :=
  (l.drop (a - 1)).take (b - a + 1)

/-- `cut -c A-B` applied to a single line. A line shorter than A yields "". -/
def cutLine (a b : Nat) (s : String) : String :=
  String.ofList (cutChars a b s.toList)

/-- Model of `cut -c A-B` reading stdin: argv is ["-c", "A-B"]; every input
    line is cut to its characters A..B; exit status 0. -/
def run (args stdin : List String) : List String × UInt32 :=
  match args with
  | [_, spec] =>
      (stdin.map (cutLine (parseRange spec).1 (parseRange spec).2), 0)
  | _ => ([], 1)

/-- EXIT STATUS: all input was output successfully, so the exit value is 0. -/
theorem run_exit_zero (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String) :
    (run [flag, spec] stdin).2 = 0 := rfl

/-- STDOUT relation: the output is exactly the per-line character cut applied
    to each input line, in input order. -/
theorem run_output_eq (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String) :
    (run [flag, spec] stdin).1
      = stdin.map (cutLine (parseRange spec).1 (parseRange spec).2) := rfl

/-- cut writes one output line per input line (the line/record count is
    preserved; in particular empty input produces no output). -/
theorem run_line_count (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String) :
    (run [flag, spec] stdin).1.length = stdin.length := by
  rw [run_output_eq]
  exact List.length_map _

/-- "It shall not be an error to select characters not present in the input
    line": an input line shorter than A becomes an empty output line. -/
theorem run_short_line_empty (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String)
    (i : Nat) (s : String) (hs : stdin[i]? = some s)
    (hshort : s.toList.length < (parseRange spec).1) :
    (run [flag, spec] stdin).1[i]? = some "" := by
  rw [run_output_eq, List.getElem?_map, hs]
  have hdrop : s.toList.drop ((parseRange spec).1 - 1) = [] :=
    List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hshort)
  simp [cutLine, cutChars, hdrop, String.ofList_nil]

/-- Each output line selects the closed range A..B, so it has at most
    B - A + 1 characters. -/
theorem run_line_length_bound (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String)
    (out : String) (hout : out ∈ (run [flag, spec] stdin).1) :
    out.length ≤ (parseRange spec).2 - (parseRange spec).1 + 1 := by
  rw [run_output_eq] at hout
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hout with ⟨s, _, rfl⟩
  rw [cutLine, String.length_ofList, cutChars, List.length_take]
  exact Nat.min_le_left _ _

/-- Content preservation: every character of an output line occurs in the
    corresponding input line (cut selects, it never invents characters). -/
theorem run_line_chars_from_input (flag spec : String) (stdin : List String)
    (out : String) (hout : out ∈ (run [flag, spec] stdin).1) :
    ∃ s ∈ stdin, ∀ c ∈ out.toList, c ∈ s.toList := by
  rw [run_output_eq] at hout
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hout with ⟨s, hmem, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨s, hmem, ?_⟩
  intro c hc
  rw [cutLine, String.toList_ofList] at hc
  exact List.mem_of_mem_drop (List.mem_of_mem_take hc)

end Pipeline.Generated

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_zero
spec_theorems.informal: cut -c A-B exits with status 0 (all input files were output successfully).

spec_theorems.name: run_output_eq
spec_theorems.informal: Standard output is exactly the per-line character cut applied to each input line, in input order.

spec_theorems.name: run_line_count
spec_theorems.informal: cut writes one output line per input line, so the line count is preserved and empty input produces no output.

spec_theorems.name: run_short_line_empty
spec_theorems.informal: Selecting characters not present in the input line is not an error: a line shorter than A becomes an empty output line.

spec_theorems.name: run_line_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: Each output line contains at most B - A + 1 characters, the size of the closed selected range A..B.

spec_theorems.name: run_line_chars_from_input
spec_theorems.informal: Content preservation: every character of an output line occurs in its originating input line; cut selects but never invents characters.
